# NovoTech Machine Tools Inc.

> Metalworking and metal fabrication machinery supplier in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. Sells, installs and supports press brakes, laser cutters, shears, ironworkers, plate rollers, angle rolls, bandsaws, cold saws, rebar benders and cutters, pipe benders, hydraulic presses, bevelers, deburring and finishing machines, notchers and press brake tooling. Machines are supplied with CSA-approved electrical panels and supported with spare parts and technical support from Canada.

Contact: +1 647 526 5510 · info (at) NovoTechMachineTools.com · 1365 Mid-Way Blvd, Unit 26, Mississauga, ON L5T 2J5, Canada.
NovoTech is appointing independent sales agents and dealers in cities and provinces across Canada; enquiries through the quote form on any product page or by phone.
Social: YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@NovoTechMachineTools · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/novotech-machine-tools-inc/ · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/novotechmachinetoolscanada · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/novotech_machinetools/
Brands represented include GMS GöçMakSan (rebar machinery), Dener (press brakes, shears, lasers), İşitan, Şahinler, Bekamak, Pilous, Gecam, CKEMSA, LFSS, Hidroliksan, Cevisa and EUROSTAMP tooling.

## Product pages

- [Rebar benders and rebar cutters (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-bender-and-cutter): every GMS rebar machine NovoTech supplies, with a single-bar capacity table for the whole range.
- [Rebar benders](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-bending-machines): stationary B and BS series benders (Ø1″–Ø2-3/8″ / 26–60 mm), portable MG and BT benders on 110/220 V, SL stirrup benders, SX and AXIS 50S spiral benders, dowel bar benders, the MAX 40 combined bender-cutter and HB/MH mesh machines — specification tables in inches and millimetres, photos and videos.
- [Rebar cutters](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-cutter): hydraulic H series (H 26–H 55), mechanical M series (M 36–M 55), double-acting SH 45 and SH 60, and the portable POWER 24 — cutting capacities for one or two bars at 45/65/85 kg/mm² steel.
- [Automatic rebar processing lines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/automatic-rebar-processing-lines): SLS 12 CNC stirrup bender from coil, MATRIX 55 / 55S shear lines, SYNCLONE 45S servo double bender — technical specifications, capacities and videos.
- [Plate rollers & slip rolls (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/plate-rollers): İşitan plate rolling machines — hydraulic 4-roll and 3-roll plate rollers, motorized plate rolls and manual slip rolls from 2 ft to 10.2 ft, capacity table for all 134 models, plate roller buying guide.
- [Hydraulic 4-roll plate rollers](https://novotechmachinetools.com/hydraulic-4-roll-plate-rollers): İşitan 4R HMS 650x80 – 3100x250 (36 models, up to 1/2″ plate, NC control and automation), 4R OM / 4R HOM corrugated sheet rolls, 4RH 10x90.
- [Hydraulic 3-roll plate rollers](https://novotechmachinetools.com/hydraulic-3-roll-plate-rollers): İşitan MRM-H 650x80 – 3100x250 initial-pinch plate rolls (32 models) and 3R HMD 1270/1550/2050.
- [Motorized 3-roll plate rollers](https://novotechmachinetools.com/motorized-plate-rollers): İşitan MRM-S 1050–3050 (21 models, composite-panel version), IRM 1050–2550, RM 1050–2050.
- [Slip rolls](https://novotechmachinetools.com/slip-rolls): İşitan IR motorized slip rolls, R manual slip rolls (bench and floor), RS manual plate rolls, RST / RST-M economical rolls.
- [Bead rollers & beading machines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/bead-rollers): İşitan HIBKS / IBKS 4.0 and 2.5 hydraulic and motorized bead rollers (8 ga and 12 ga), IBKS 1.8, IKM / IKMP 1.2 motorized and IK / IKS manual bead rollers — roll sets, specification tables in inches.
- [Circle cutting machines & lock seamers](https://novotechmachinetools.com/circle-cutters-and-seamers): İşitan IDK 1 – IDK 5 circle shears (Ø4.3″ to Ø78.7″, 20 ga to 3/16″, inside-diameter cutting and flanging) and the LS-13P pneumatic lock seamer.
- [Compact hydraulic press brakes](https://novotechmachinetools.com/compact-hydraulic-press-brakes): İşitan Edgebender 1230 / 1540 / 2160 NC 2-axis press brakes (33–66 US tons, 4.2–6.9 ft) and the Edgebender 1240 CNC 3-axis with Cybelec Cybtouch 12 — Promecam tooling, Leuze light guard, specification tables in inches.
- [Pipe benders & tube bending machines (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/pipe-benders): every İşitan tube and pipe bender — CNC and NC mandrel benders, compact and aluminum-profile benders, BK rotary draw benders — with a capacity table for the whole range.
- [CNC tube benders](https://novotechmachinetools.com/cnc-tube-benders): İşitan SFB 38 / 51 / 65 / 76 / 90-CNC/A3 3-axis and SFB 38 / 51 / 65-CNC/A5 5-axis servo mandrel benders, Ø1-1/2″ to Ø3-1/2″ × 8 ga, 21″ touchscreen CNC with 3D simulation.
- [NC tube benders](https://novotechmachinetools.com/nc-tube-benders): İşitan SFB 38 – 90-NC hydraulic mandrel benders with 10″ touchscreen NC, SFB NC/C carrier models with servo rotation, SFB 32-HD / 32-M compact benders, SFB 38-NC/A aluminum-profile benders.
- [Rotary draw tube benders](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rotary-draw-tube-benders): İşitan BK-42, BK-050, BK-H 060 and BK 030 (76) non-mandrel benders for pipe to 2-1/2″ NPS, Ø3″ steel tube, solid bar, flat bar and box section — capacity matrix by material.
- [Tube notchers, end formers & deburring](https://novotechmachinetools.com/tube-notchers-and-end-formers): İşitan PN 17/90 and PN 20/76 belt-sander pipe notchers (11/16″ to 3-1/2″ OD, to 50°), SFF 90-1 / 60-1 hydraulic pipe-end formers (expand and reduce to Ø3-1/2″), TD-01 tube-end deburring machine.
- [Circular cold saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/circular-cold-saws): İşitan SFC 350-VX semi-automatic and SFC 275 / 315-VP and -V pull-down cold saws, 10-3/4″ to 13-3/4″ blades, round to Ø4-1/2″, mitre 45° both ways.
- [Metal cutting band saws / bandsaws (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/band-saw): horizontal metal cutting band saws (metal bandsaws, band saw machines for metal) in two lines — premium Bekamak (Turkey) and NovoTech's own value line (NT series) — with a capacity table for each line, a band saw buying guide (sizes, pivot vs double column, blades, speeds and feeds, troubleshooting) and FAQs.
- [Bekamak manual band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/bekamak-manual-band-saws): BMS 230DG / 270DG gravity-feed double-miter saws, Ø9″–10-5/8″.
- [Bekamak semi-automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/bekamak-semi-automatic-band-saws): BMSY DG/DGH double-miter, 320G/GL single-miter and straight-cut saws, Ø9″–17-3/8″ (230–440 mm).
- [Bekamak automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/bekamak-automatic-band-saws): BMSO roller-feed, BMSO E encoder-feed NC, 350GA single-miter NC, GS servo-feed and 270DGS motorized-feed NC saws.
- [Bekamak double-column band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/bekamak-double-column-band-saws): BMSY C / CGH / DG NC, BMSO C / CS / CGS / XS and heavy-duty saws from Ø13″ to 59″ (330–1500 mm).
- [NovoTech value line semi-automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/novotech-semi-automatic-band-saws): BS-315GF full-hydraulic, BS-460G / 460G-JC, BS-2114TH, BS-5030 single-column, BS-650GA — hydraulic saws Ø10″–18″.
- [NovoTech value line automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/novotech-automatic-band-saws): BS300x370 / 300x370H roller-feed, BS-5040 single-column, BS-460GB swivel-head miter saw with 20 ft stand, BS-500G / 500GT / 650G / 850G CNC servo saws.
- [NovoTech value line double-column band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/novotech-double-column-band-saws): TBK-4228 / 4228A / 4228B / 4228B (improved), TGK-4235 / 4240 and GZ4250/70 / 24 gantry saws, Ø11″–23-5/8″.
